prompts.prompt: "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing $MinSize = 650KB # 665,600 bytes $MaxSize = 1900KB # 1,945,600 bytes $TargetLow = 750KB # Target size when expanding small files $TargetHigh = 1600KB # Target size when compressing large files function Get-JpegCodec { return [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders() | Where-Object { $_.MimeType -eq 'image/jpeg' } } $jpegCodec = Get-JpegCodec $files = Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -match '^\.(jpe?g)$' } Write-Host "Found $($files.Count) image(s). Processing..." -ForegroundColor Cyan foreach ($file in $files) { $currentLength = $file.Length # 1. FILE IS TOO LARGE (> 1900 KB) -> Compress to ~1600 KB if ($currentLength -gt $MaxSize) { Write-Host "Compressing (>1900KB): $($file.Name) [$([math]::Round($currentLength/1KB, 1)) KB]" -ForegroundColor Yellow $tempPath = "$($file.FullName).tmp" try { # Fully clone image into memory to avoid GDI+ lock $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file.FullName) $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(,$bytes) $rawImg = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromStream($ms) $img = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($rawImg) $rawImg.Dispose() $ms.Dispose() $quality = 90 $bestQuality = 80 while ($quality -ge 20) { $encoderParams = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters(1) $encoderParams.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter( [System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, [long]$quality ) $testMs = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream $img.Save($testMs, $jpegCodec, $encoderParams) $testSize = $testMs.Length $testMs.Dispose() $encoderParams.Dispose() if ($testSize -le $TargetHigh) { $bestQuality = $quality break } $quality -= 5 $bestQuality = $quality } # Write final compressed version $encoderParams = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters(1) $encoderParams.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter( [System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, [long]$bestQuality ) $img.Save($tempPath, $jpegCodec, $encoderParams) $img.Dispose() $encoderParams.Dispose() Move-Item -Path $tempPath -Destination $file.FullName -Force Write-Host " -> Compressed to: $([math]::Round((Get-Item $file.FullName).Length/1KB, 1)) KB" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Warning "Failed on $($file.FullName): $_" if (Test-Path $tempPath) { Remove-Item $tempPath -Force } } } # 2. FILE IS TOO SMALL (< 650 KB) -> Safely pad byte size to ~750 KB without quality loss elseif ($currentLength -lt $MinSize) { Write-Host "Increasing size (<650KB): $($file.Name) [$([math]::Round($currentLength/1KB, 1)) KB]" -ForegroundColor Cyan try { $bytesNeeded = $TargetLow - $currentLength if ($bytesNeeded -gt 0) { $padding = New-Object byte[] $bytesNeeded $fs = [System.IO.File]::Open($file.FullName, [System.IO.FileMode]::Append, [System.IO.FileAccess]::Write) $fs.Write($padding, 0, $padding.Length) $fs.Close() $fs.Dispose() Write-Host " -> Padded to: $([math]::Round((Get-Item $file.FullName).Length/1KB, 1)) KB" -ForegroundColor Green } } catch { Write-Warning "Failed to pad $($file.FullName): $_" } } } Write-Host "`nAll images processed." -ForegroundColor Green"

prompts.title: png-to jpg
prompts.prompt: "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing # Automatically targets whatever folder PowerShell is currently open in $rootPath = (Get-Location).Path $minBytes = 650 * 1024 # 665,600 bytes (~650 KB) $maxBytes = 1999 * 1024 # 2,046,976 bytes (~1999 KB) # Locate JPEG Codec $jpegCodec = [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders() | Where-Object { $_.MimeType -eq "image/jpeg" } function Save-ImageWithQuality { param( [System.Drawing.Bitmap]$Bitmap, [long]$Quality ) $encoderParams = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters(1) $encoderParams.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter( [System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, $Quality ) $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream $Bitmap.Save($ms, $jpegCodec, $encoderParams) return $ms } # Recursively find ONLY PNG files in current folder and all subfolders $pngFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $rootPath -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -ieq '.png' } if (-not $pngFiles) { Write-Host "No PNG files found in: $rootPath" -ForegroundColor Yellow return } Write-Host "Found $($pngFiles.Count) PNG image(s) to convert in: $rootPath`n" -ForegroundColor Cyan foreach ($file in $pngFiles) { Write-Host "Processing: $($file.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Cyan $outPath = [System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($file.FullName, ".jpg") $tempOut = $outPath + ".tmp" try { # Safely read bytes into memory to prevent file locks $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file.FullName) $inStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(,$bytes) $srcImage = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromStream($inStream) # Keep exact width & height, handle transparency with clean white $canvas = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($srcImage.Width, $srcImage.Height, [System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat]::Format24bppRgb) $graphics = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($canvas) $graphics.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::White) $graphics.DrawImage($srcImage, 0, 0, $srcImage.Width, $srcImage.Height) $graphics.Dispose() $srcImage.Dispose() $inStream.Dispose() # Step 1: Find best JPEG quality (1-100) under 1999 KB $low = 1 $high = 100 $bestBytes = $null while ($low -le $high) { $mid = [math]::Floor(($low + $high) / 2) $ms = Save-ImageWithQuality -Bitmap $canvas -Quality $mid $len = $ms.Length if ($len -le $maxBytes) { $bestBytes = $ms.ToArray() $low = $mid + 1 # Try higher quality } else { $high = $mid - 1 # Reduce compression } $ms.Dispose() } if ($null -eq $bestBytes) { $ms = Save-ImageWithQuality -Bitmap $canvas -Quality 1 $bestBytes = $ms.ToArray() $ms.Dispose() } # Step 2: Inject JPEG COM metadata padding if under 650 KB if ($bestBytes.Length -lt $minBytes) { $needed = $minBytes - $bestBytes.Length $padStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream # Write SOI marker (0xFF, 0xD8) $padStream.Write($bestBytes, 0, 2) while ($needed -gt 0) { $chunk = [Math]::Min($needed, 65530) if ($chunk -lt 4) { $chunk = 4 } $padLength = [uint16]$chunk $padStream.WriteByte(0xFF) $padStream.WriteByte(0xFE) $padStream.WriteByte([byte](($padLength -shr 8) -band 0xFF)) $padStream.WriteByte([byte]($padLength -band 0xFF)) $payload = New-Object byte[] ($chunk - 2) $padStream.Write($payload, 0, $payload.Length) $needed -= ($chunk + 2) } # Write remainder of original JPEG stream $padStream.Write($bestBytes, 2, $bestBytes.Length - 2) $finalBytes = $padStream.ToArray() $padStream.Dispose() } else { $finalBytes = $bestBytes } # Save new JPG and delete old PNG [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($tempOut, $finalBytes) $canvas.Dispose() Remove-Item -Path $file.FullName -Force Move-Item -Path $tempOut -Destination $outPath -Force $finalSizeKB = [math]::Round((Get-Item $outPath).Length / 1KB, 2) Write-Host " Done: $outPath ($finalSizeKB KB)" -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host " Error processing $($file.Name): $_" -ForegroundColor Red if (Test-Path $tempOut) { Remove-Item $tempOut -Force } } } Write-Host "`nAll PNG images converted successfully!" -ForegroundColor Yellow"
